name: EndoMaster
description: EndoMaster Pte Ltd was a Singaporean medical robotics company spun out from Nanyang Technological University (NTU) and the National University of Singapore (NUS) by Prof. Louis Phee and Prof. Lawrence Ho. The company developed the MASTER and [EndoMaster EASE](/robot/endomaster_ease) flexible endoscopic robotic systems for natural-orifice endoluminal procedures before entering voluntary liquidation in 2024.

status.note: Placed into creditors' voluntary winding up / liquidation in 2024.
